# cloudsigma_server_availability_groups (Data Source)

The server availability groups data source lists which servers currently run on the same physical host.
Pair it with the server `avoid_name_prefix` hint to check that the hint was honoured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudsigma_server_availability_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of List of String) One entry per physical host: the UUIDs of the servers sharing it.
- `id` (String) Static identifier of the data source.
